title: Event Dispatch Table with Function Pointers
description:
Function pointer tables decouple event producers from handlers, forming the basis of finite state machines and interrupt dispatchers in embedded systems.

### Requirements:
1. Define a dispatch table containing pairs of `{ event_id, handler_func }`.
2. Implement `dispatch_event(uint8_t event_id, uint32_t data)`: Look up `event_id`, execute its handler, and return 0. Return -1 if event is unregistered.
hint: A lookup table lookup is cleaner and more maintainable than large, sprawling `switch(event_id)` statements when handlers are dynamically registered or modular.
